Test Your Relationship: The Quiz for Two

20 questions to discover your compatibility level. Take turns and see if you're truly on the same wavelength!

Why Test Your Relationship?

Strengthen Your Connection

Discover your common ground and better understand the differences that enrich your relationship.

Open the Dialogue

Every question is an opportunity for discussion and sharing with your partner.

Identify Areas for Growth

Your score helps you see where you can grow together and which aspects of your relationship deserve attention.

Have Fun Together

Beyond the score, it's a playful and intimate moment to share as a couple.

How Does It Work?

Enter your names

Enter the names and genders of both players

Answer in turns

For each question, player 1 answers first, then player 2

Discover your score

The more identical answers you have, the higher your score!

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the couple test really free?
Yes, our couple test is 100% free and requires no registration. You can take it as many times as you like.
How long does the test take?
The test takes about 5 minutes. It includes 20 questions that both partners answer in turns.
How is the score calculated?
The score is based on the number of identical answers between both partners. The more you answer the same, the higher your compatibility score!
